abstract.t: This document describes the mechanism Umarise uses for temporal anchoring of digital artifacts: cryptographic hashes are committed to the Bitcoin blockchain via the OpenTimestamps protocol. The resulting proof is independently verifiable by any party with access to independently validated Bitcoin chain data, without contacting Umarise or any other anchoring service. The document is published so that other parties can produce and verify such proofs. The SCITT Architecture is used as the primary integration example; no changes to it are required.
